Join a highly respected Australian defence technology organisation delivering complex engineering programs that support critical national capabilities. With a strong focus on innovation and project excellence, this organisation offers the opportunity to contribute to the delivery of sophisticated, software-intensive systems within a highly collaborative environment.  
  Role Description     
  As the Configuration Management Officer, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and maintaining CM activities across the full project lifecycle. Acting as the primary point of contact for CM-related matters, you will ensure configuration control processes are effectively implemented and maintained while supporting engineering, project, and IT teams.  
  Key Responsibilities  
 
  Execute and maintain CM activities across all project stages, recording and maintaining product hierarchies and identifiers within baseline documentation.  
  Act as Secretary to the Configuration Control Board (CCB), circulating paperwork, scheduling meetings, and ensuring change processes are successfully completed.  
  Maintain a detailed inventory of assets, including operating system versions, patch statuses, and installed applications.  
  Collaborate with IT and administration staff to maintain and improve the CM system, including library environments, access privileges, and backups.  
  Establish requirements for supplier delivery of data products, document timely receipts, and assess data acceptability.  
  Perform physical and functional audits of systems and software to verify compliance with established baselines, providing input to the Quality Manager.  
 
  Key Skills & Attributes  
 
  Configuration & Data Management: Deep functional knowledge of CM and Data Management principles and their associated tools.  
  IT & Engineering Acumen: Proficiency in IT combined with a solid understanding of project and engineering management lifecycles.  
  Analytical Problem-Solving: A structured and analytical approach to problem identification and resolution.  
  Meticulous Precision: Exceptional attention to detail when planning and performing all configuration tasks.  
  Communication & Collaboration: The ability to communicate clearly and concisely, working effectively on your own, within the team, and with external agencies or subcontractors.  
 
  Qualifications & Experience  
 
  Security Clearance: Must hold an active NV1 Australian Defence security clearance or have the ability to obtain one.  
  Experience: 2+ years of experience using mature/commercial CM tools within an engineering lifecycle environment.  
  Technical Exposure: 2+ years of experience supporting the delivery of complex systems containing software.  
  Education: A Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, IT, or a related field is highly regarded, alongside prior Defence Industry experience.  
 
  Why Join?   Secure a rewarding opportunity to work on complex Defence projects within a supportive and technically focused environment. You will have the chance to further develop your Configuration Management expertise while contributing to critical sovereign capability programs.  
  How to Apply  
  If you have the experience to execute these critical CM functions and meet the security requirements, please apply now with your updated resume.

About Us:     Renowned for our technical excellence, ATC Williams provides Tailings, Water, and Waste Management services to the mining, resources, and governments sectors. We are a leading specialised engineering and consulting firm with over 40 years of successful service to our clients. With eight national office locations and a broad variety of international projects, we offer exciting and sustainable career pathways, whether you are a technical or professional leader, or just starting out in your career.     Why Join Us?     You will be joining our team at an exciting time as ATC Williams continue to solidify our position as a trusted and recognised engineering brand. We are embarking on a significant growth phase, represented by expansion in office locations, employees, opportunities, and capabilities.     About the Role:     We are continually looking for enthusiastic and talented people to join our team.    Our  Perth  office is currently seeking an  Experienced Engineer  on a  permanent full-time  basis.    You will work with our well experienced Civil, Geotechnical and Tailings groups to deliver projects successfully to meeting our clients’ needs. At ATC Williams, every role is supported by professionals across the business, and you will have peers, subordinates, and technical experts to share ideas with, through the varied nature of work we undertake for clients in the mining and resources, energy and property/general infrastructure sectors across Australia and globally.    You will have the opportunity to challenge yourself and fellow professionals through the works we undertake covering civil and geotechnical site investigation, materials test planning, laboratory testing, modelling, engineering analyses and design, construction, field inspections and tailings life cycle management (from concept to closure).        Key responsibilities and activities include:         An uncompromised commitment to safety in all aspects of your work including Safety in Design and promoting a safety culture in every aspect of your work.    Strong work ethic and the ability to work independently and in a team environment.    Assist in developing proposals for new work, including project scoping and costing.    Managing project tasks / small projects under the guidance of senior staff / Project Managers.    Undertaking and / or assisting in managing / overseeing geotechnical investigations including site work, laboratory and desktop investigations and preparing factual and interpretative reports.    Undertake technical design tasks and preparation of related documentation (under the guidance of senior staff / project managers), including geotechnical and hydraulic analyses such as stability, seepage, flood management and infrastructure design assessments.    Working at the direction of senior technical staff or technical experts.    Assist in developing practical solutions to add value to our clients needs.    Ensuring time management and quality to required standards to meet project requirements.    Work as part of a project team, delivering technical tasks and reports that summarise outcomes of the projects, including the review of construction records and verification of design implementation against project requirements.    Liaise with clients, contractors, and multidisciplinary project teams to support project delivery, technical coordination and stakeholder communication.    Undertake numerical modelling and engineering assessments to support design development, risk evaluation and project decision-making.    Knowledge sharing, mentoring junior staff and working collaboratively with local and global teams.     Read more: https://workinitiatives.com.au/job/details?id=5990095

Dunsteel Engineering Pty Ltd

Location - Moss Vale NSW

Dunsteel Engineering Pty Ltd is a leading steel fabrication business with over 50 years of experience. We specialise in delivering complex projects for leading building firms and architects. Dunsteel are at the forefront of prefabricated stairway design for large multistorey buildings. We are currently seeking to fill the position of Welder who will be responsible for:

Main task:
Read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and standards to establish the job requirements.
Plan the work sequence accordingly.
Select and prepare metal stock.
Carry out trial fits for mechanical/structural assemblies.
Conduct welding operations to build armoured steel welded assemblies in accordance with the Drawings, Quality Standards and Safety requirements.
Finish product by cleaning, polishing, filing, or bathing in acid solutions, or by applying protective or decorative coatings.
Exam, use and maintain tools and equipment safely.
Maintaining appropriate stock levels of spare parts
Conduct quality checks to ensure welded components meet industry standards and project specifications.

Required Experience, Skills and Qualifications:
Relevant Trade Qualification
At least 2 years relevant experience
Strong proficiency in Mig welding techniques and processes.
Knowledge of welding equipment and tools, and ability to perform routine maintenance.
Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and quality in work.
Work Health Safety (WHS) knowledge

Salary Range
$75,000-$85,000 annually

Position
Full Time

If you meet the above criteria please apply now, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
